architecture_binding.target_scope: recipient-scoped OFFERED/DELIVERED/UPTAKEN evidence plus matched intervention/control causal falsification

source_surfaces.observed_mechanism: Replace or permute the treatment, rerun the estimator, and test whether the purported effect survives a negative-control intervention. Seeded randomness can make the procedure reproducible.

Rerun the estimate on repeated subsets; derive distinct per-simulation seeds from a fixed base seed to combine reproducibility with varied subsets; compare the resulting estimate distribution with the original.
Add a synthetic adjustment/confounding variable and rerun estimation to stress robustness to nuisance/common-cause structure.

strongest_transfer: PLACEBO_BROADCAST_NEGATIVE_CONTROL: preserve the non-broadcast input digest and probe identity while deterministically replacing/permuting the intervention broadcast binding; a claimed broadcast-caused downstream delta should disappear under the placebo control.

RECIPIENT_SUBSET_ROBUSTNESS: deterministically recompute the contract result over declared recipient subsets to expose results carried by one exceptional/missing recipient rather than complete recipient-scoped evidence.
wp507_relevance.weaker_transfer: Synthetic-confounder stress is conceptually useful but is less directly isomorphic to the current deterministic receipt contract and should not be imported before a precise provenance-preserving adapter exists.
wp507_relevance.important_mismatch: DoWhy is a statistical causal-inference framework over datasets, estimands and estimators. WP507 G3 is presently a deterministic evidence contract over exact broadcast, recipient, probe, generation and digest identities. Statistical significance or estimator stability must not be upgraded into WP507 causal proof.

counterhypotheses: The existing WP507 matched intervention/control contract may already capture the useful core of placebo refutation, making a DoWhy dependency redundant.
Converting F2 causal receipts into a dataframe/estimator pipeline could weaken exact provenance or create a derived analysis surface that users mistakenly treat as canonical evidence.
Subset/bootstrap-style robustness may be actively misleading when WP507 requires complete evidence from every declared broadcast recipient rather than population-level stability.
A small native deterministic negative-control test suite may provide more value, less dependency weight, and stronger replay semantics than importing DoWhy.

adjudication.recommended_next_gate: Consume the already-claimed parallel DoWhy E2 architecture-mapping lane; require it to compare full import against native placebo-broadcast and recipient-subset falsifiers, with exact provenance and fail-closed completeness preserved.
